title: AdAccount
description: An Ad Account contains advertising campaigns and is owned by an Organization. Each Ad Account has one or more Funding Sources.

id.description: The unique identifier of the ad account

name.description: The name of the ad account

status.description: The status of the ad account

organization_id.description: The ID of the parent organization

funding_source_ids.description: Array of funding source IDs associated with this account

currency.description: The currency code for the ad account (e.g., USD)

timezone.description: The timezone of the ad account (e.g., America/Los_Angeles)
